capabilities: Look up citation metadata from Crossref, OpenAlex, arXiv, and Europe PMC for a DOI
Create a Markdown literature note from a configurable template
Download and save an accessible paper PDF into the vault
Show import progress and report PDF save results
Configure note folder, PDF folder, and template paths
extras: PDF download is explicitly best-effort; paywalled or blocked publishers still get a note but no PDF. Installation is a manual folder copy, not a community plugin store install. Manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a DOI into a formatted literature note with citation metadata.

relations.evidence: Looks up citation metadata from Crossref and OpenAlex.
Looks up citation metadata from Crossref and OpenAlex.
Uses arXiv metadata for 10.48550/arXiv.<id> DOIs, including the abstract
Tries Europe PMC for abstracts and keywords

summary: DOI importer that creates literature notes from Crossref, OpenAlex, and arXiv metadata, with configurable note paths and optional PDF download.
